newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end strong on economic reports.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end strong on economic reports.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed sharply higher Tuesday after a fall in a key measure of manufacturing activity soothed Wall Street's fears of an over-heating economy and a near-term rise in interest rates by the Federal Reserve.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 49.54 points higher at 7,722.33. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 16-11 on active volume of 547 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
